name: browser-use
headline: Skills-Market: TaskMarket Agent Commerce Plugin
short_description: A Claude Code plugin that connects AI agents to the Daydreams TaskMarket, enabling agents to discover, estimate, and complete agentic commerce tasks for rewards.
author: daydreamsai

sections.overview:
Skills-market is a Claude Code plugin (`.claude-plugin`) built by Daydreamsai that integrates AI agents with TaskMarket, a marketplace for agentic computing tasks. It supports task types including api-agent, pr-code, and pr-docs, and includes a task-estimator skill that calculates per-phase token budgets across Read, Plan, Execute, and Verify stages. The estimator outputs USD compute costs at Sonnet pricing and provides a profit verdict with margin percentage versus task reward, helping agents evaluate whether a task is worth completing. Communication between agents is handled via XMTP messaging commands, with daemon mode support for continuous inbox and task polling. Developers building autonomous agents on Claude Code can use this skill to participate in and profit from decentralized agentic task markets.
Estimate compute cost and profit margin before an agent accepts a TaskMarket task
Run a Claude agent in daemon mode to continuously poll for and complete TaskMarket tasks
Use XMTP messaging commands to send, query, and listen for task-related agent communications
Automate PR code review or API agent tasks and earn rewards through TaskMarket
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/daydreamsai/skills-market`
sections.usage:
```
Imagine a skills market where AI agents can autonomously buy and sell skills. What would be the top 5 most valuable skills in this market? Consider skills that are in high demand, can be automated, and have a clear ROI. Focus on skills that would be useful for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Provide a brief description of each skill and why it would be valuable.
```

